note: Rustic state forest campground on the west side of Mio Pond, the Au Sable River impoundment at Mio Dam; secluded wooded sites. A separate paddle-in group camp sits on the east side. Managed by Rifle River Recreation Area. 2 mi NW of Mio via Morenci Avenue, Pond Drive and South Gerber Road. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: the 24 individual drive-in sites are sold at $20 a night (not only group camping; the 10-site group camp is a separate paddle-in area), count confirmed; vault toilets (confirmed); not reservable (confirmed). Page has no 'what to expect' block, so electric, hand-pump water, first-come and the 15-day maximum stay are left as derived. Season (Dec 1 - Apr 15 closure) already manual. Type 'rustic', ORV operation to trails 'no', boat ramp. Note: directions corrected (page: 2 mi NW via Morenci Ave, Pond Dr, S Gerber Rd, not 3 mi via M-33 & Popps Rd), field restatements and the aggregator remark trimmed.
